svg.text: Group 30 software block diagram: vehicle controller on micro T-Kernel 3.0 (both RP2040 cores)
MQTT broker · web page with Start, Stop and the barcode actions · decodes the packed records into one run log
pri 4 · core 0 · owns the CYW43 radio (PIO1), lwIP and MQTT; no application task calls them
Checks the Wi-Fi link every 500 ms
Owns: line IR DO GP26, GP27
The only task that drives the
Motor hold: the only task that
IF-09 on a hump: hold the barcode trigger (spin lock)
IF-11 lift count (one byte): lifted or overturned, so hold the motors
Stop paths: every stop goes through tScan, the only task that sets INHIBIT. It polls every loop (10 ms delay) and never waits on the servo or an echo.
Lift or overturn: terrain_task (100 ms mean; overturn 300 ms) → IF-11 → tScan next loop → INHIBIT → tMotion brakes (limit 20 ms; 251 µs measured)
Obstacle: ping every 60 ms → first reading under 150 mm → INHIBIT in the same loop. Stall or bypass fault: tMotion event → tScan → INHIBIT
Dashboard Stop: /cmd → run flag → tScan next loop → INHIBIT. It needs Wi-Fi; lifting the car is the stop that does not.
cyc_motion: TICK every 20 ms to tMotion
No reader waits: one word, double
buffer, sequence check or spin lock
IF numbers are the interface IDs in TEAM.md section 5. pri = task priority (1 is highest).
